invariants.rationale: Method is invoked on an instance; 'this' must be non-null at method entry.
The method accesses 'buttons.size' and 'buttons.get(i)', which implies 'buttons' must not be null.
The minCheckCount field likely represents a minimum count and typical usage indicates it should not be negative.
By convention, collection sizes are non-negative; 'buttons.size' is used as upper loop bound.
